title: Private research satellites remain blocked before Actions runner allocation
summary: Two independent private research repositories currently show the same GitHub Actions failure mode: jobs are created and immediately fail without any runner assignment or executed steps. divine-providence exact-head ARGUS/federation runs and icarus-csv-evidence-lab watchdog CI both exhibit steps=[] while the public canonical ICARUS repository continues to receive normal GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows runners. This is infrastructure evidence, not a code-test verdict; affected private-repository merge gates remain closed until real runners execute the required tests.
evidence: reppiks490/divine-providence PR #44 head 9150646e058a97e8212d50a3f37aaf4ea6eb9bfe run 37056448239: all required jobs completed failure with steps=[] and no runner assignment
reppiks490/divine-providence PR #48 head 55827d6721aca6317c1f94c93e99a8c0968ceac2 run 37063897928: all eight required jobs completed failure with steps=[] and no runner assignment
reppiks490/icarus-csv-evidence-lab PR #3 head 4676998db9803257b5e01cc0a51b5327ff268bbc run 37075786278: watchdog-tests completed failure with steps=[] and no runner assignment

reppiks490/Icarus is public and continues to allocate hosted Linux/Windows runners normally; therefore the evidence isolates the observed failure pattern to private-repository Actions paths rather than a universal GitHub Actions outage
exact account/billing/quota/permission cause is not asserted because current repository tooling does not expose sufficient administrative evidence
